facts.fact: The Data Protection Act, 2021 (Act 3 of 2021) was assented to on 23 March 2021 and, per its commencement history, commenced on 1 April 2021 under the Data Protection Act (Commencement) Order, 2021.

Section 4 of the Act establishes the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner in the ministry responsible for communications, and section 5 has the President appoint the Commissioner through the Civil Service Commission.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner

facts.fact: The Act's record lists the Data Protection (Registration and Licensing) Regulations, 2021 (Statutory Instrument 58 of 2021) as its subsidiary legislation, made under section 82.
